visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video is a live-action production featuring a man with wet black hair and a white headband labeled with Chinese characters. He stands outdoors on a paved area near green grass and tall urban buildings under a bright, sunny sky. He wears a light blue short-sleeved button-down shirt over a white undershirt and light purple shorts. He shouts and makes exaggerated facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where he stands in front of a chain-link fence, making a running gesture while yellow text overlays appear in front of him. Bright sunlight flares from the upper corner, creating a hazy, high-key atmosphere as he looks upward and grimaces. (3) He is seen near a leafy green tree where digital fire graphics flicker around his feet. He reacts with shock and begins to run down a sidewalk adjacent to a busy road with cars passing by. The camera follows him in a handheld tracking motion. (4) He approaches a person sitting on a dark scooter under a shaded building overhang. As he sits on the back of the scooter, orange fire overlays appear on the seat. He reacts as if in extreme pain, twisting his body and eventually falling onto the concrete floor in a crumpled pose. (5) Close-up shots show the man sweating profusely while talking directly into the camera. He notices a woman with pink hair tied back in a ponytail wearing a black dress walking away. He follows her and taps her shoulder. (6) The person turns around, revealing it is a man wearing heavy, smudged makeup with red lipstick and dark eyeshadow, appearing disheveled. The main character reacts with exaggerated horror and surprise, looking up at the sky. (7) A montage shows various characters dancing and the main character sitting on the ground looking exhausted. He then spots a woman in a black leather jacket riding a motorcycle. (8) The woman stops, removes her white helmet, and unzips her jacket to reveal a revealing red top. She looks refreshed and unaffected by the heat. The main character appears behind her, looking confused and amazed. (9) The woman holds up various CoCo branded beverages, including a milk tea with pearls and a yellow mango smoothie. Close-up product shots show the condensation on the cups and the textures of the ingredients. The two characters are then seen on a rooftop with a city skyline backdrop, happily drinking the beverages together.

The speech is fast and projected with a straining quality. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a shift in the music's rhythm. The male voice continues to grunt and shout 'Hoo hoo' in a rhythmic fashion, synchronized with comedic physical actions heard in the visual. (3) A distinct 'ding' bell sound effect marks a transition. The background music maintains a driving beat while the male voice shouts about the heat. (4) A sizzling SFX is heard as the male voice screams in high-pitched agony, simulating a burning sensation. This is followed by a dull 'thud' sound. (5) A dramatic horror-style musical stinger plays as a new male voice (in drag) responds, followed by a comedic 'slide whistle' or similar goofy sound effect. (6) The music transitions into a smoother, more promotional pop track. A clear female voice begins a professional, enthusiastic narration describing the CoCo beverage, accompanied by 'slurping' and 'refreshing' sound effects. (7) The video ends with synchronized cheers from both male and female voices over a final musical crescendo and a sharp 'click' or UI sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Conflict -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic and exaggerated narrative about enduring extreme summer heat to promote CoCo's refreshing beverages. The protagonist's struggle with the sun serves as a relatable hook, leading to the product reveal as the ultimate 'heat-relief' solution.
